headline: Healthcare Product Builder | SaaS and AI-Powered Care | MBBS-Trained Physician
summary: Healthcare product builder who has spent four years at Greenway Health working directly with customers and product teams on a cloud EHR, and now runs Roovero, an AI SaaS product I took from discovery to launch and iterate with paying pilot clients. At Greenway I wrote PRDs from recurring customer problems, worked with product and engineering to get them built, and served as clinical lead for a new AI-first EHR. MBBS-trained physician, so I understand how care is delivered and where software gets in the way.
greenway_bullets: Clinical lead for a new AI-first EHR from Aug 2025: defined provider personas and user goals, mapped end-to-end clinical workflows and identified where agentic automation could remove clinician burden.
Wrote PRDs and feature requests from recurring client pain points and worked with product and engineering teams to get them built; many shipped to clients.
Turned clinician needs into UX designs and interactive React prototypes built with AI tools, aligning product, engineering and clients before engineering handoff.
Voice of the customer to product and design teams on a platform serving 100+ enrolled practices; features I shaped or advocated for shipped with positive client feedback.
Owned implementations for close to 200 client practices: ran discovery on pain points, configured practice-specific workflows and trained 200+ providers, NPs, nurses and medical assistants.
Patient Safety Committee, Functional Advisory Committee and Clinical Content Team: triaged defects and patient safety issues through stage-gate release.
Presented product and AI feature concepts to clients and at the Greenway Engage provider conference.
skills: customer discovery, user research, personas, PRDs and user stories, backlog prioritisation, prototyping, stakeholder alignment, product launch and iteration
EHR workflows, clinical documentation, patient safety review, agentic workflow scoping, prompt design, evaluation rubrics, RAG-based support
React, Flutter, Firebase, Next.js, Claude Code, Codex, GitHub, n8n
thesis_html: Software for care teams works when someone who has delivered care helps decide what gets built.
facts: Practices on the platform I advised on
